findings.description: The rubric requires a test that fails when each new validator is deleted. ClipOrigin.contract, FirstView.contract and BindingContext.contract lack such tests. Every exercised origin has consistent origin/plan fields and an original clip; every exercised view/context has correctly typed pins. The forged-context test exercises stored chronology, while duplicate-origin and concurrent-view tests exercise separate admission checks. Removing these model validators therefore leaves those tests satisfied. In particular, no test independently proves rejection of PLANNED without a plan, FOUND with a plan, a non-original origin clip, or wrong-kind view/context pins. This conclusion follows from the inspected test inputs and control flow; full runtime mutation testing was unavailable.

evidence: Compared lifecycle documentation and CLI help against implemented origin mapping, provenance derivation, UNKNOWN preservation, access-attempt semantics and frozen exports.
Checked revised installer/checksum descriptions against scripts/install_media_tools.py and the retained toolchain record; checked extraction options against media.py.

Applied the A2 boundary: external dependency and standards claims are research requests, without an accuracy penalty; harness bookkeeping and earlier researcher claims were not graded as current builder claims.
